summary: Mid-market enterprise CSaaS provider focused on chat-first deflection and agent augmentation. Cost-sensitive: needs sub-$0.002 per deflected message economics at scale; peak traffic patterns include flash sales and daily peaks. Interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput + Optimize for batching/quant recommendations.
notes:
Context / background:
- Founded 2018, platform used by several ecommerce retailers and fintechs. High-volume chat channel: 150M user messages/yr (projected).
- Primary goal: maximize automated deflection while preserving NPS and SLA. Want reliable fallbacks for safety-critical flows.

Technical requirements and preferences:
- Workloads: real-time chat deflection (priority), ticket summarization, agent assist snippets, tool-calling for internal CRM lookups.
- Latency targets: tail p95 end-to-end < 400ms for deflected responses; interactive agent-assist < 250ms desired.
- Throughput: baseline 2,500 msgs/min (42 qps), expected peak 12,000 msgs/min (200 qps) during promos; ability to absorb 3x synthetic spike for 15 minutes.
- Cost sensitivity: target < $0.002 per deflection (includes generation + rerank). Budget pressure from customers on price per conversation.
- Models: prefer smaller quantized variants for deflection (4-bit/8-bit options) and larger Llama/OPT family for high-risk escalation. Want automated routing to fallback model when confidence low.
- Efficiency asks: batching + KV/prefix caching to reduce token work for repeated conversational patterns; persistent short-term cache for returning sessions.
- Observability: per-route latency & token cost, token-level billing split, SLO alerts on p95 latency and per-minute QPS.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must integrate with Okta SSO (SAML) and corporate KMS for key management.
- Data residency: certain EU customer traffic must stay in EU tenant.
- SOC2 is required; ISO27001 is preferred. Audit logs mandatory for agent interactions.

Sales / timeline / POC:
- 2-week technical POC requested: Redwood to provision Dedicated pool (or hosted equivalent) that matches their peak QPS for a 48-hour soak + 1 synthetic flash sale run.
- POC success metrics: cost-per-deflection, model accuracy delta vs current rules engine, p95 latency under 400ms, cache hit-rate target > 30%.
- Asked for quantization profile recommendations (int8 vs 4-bit) and expected performance/cost tradeoffs.

Recent activity (timeline):
- 2026-01-15: Intro call (Jordan P, AE) — high-level use-case and budget.
- 2026-01-27: Technical deep-dive with infra and platform (Priya M) — discussed routing, SSO, KMS.
- 2026-02-10: Demo of hosted API; customer asked for Dedicated numbers.
- 2026-02-21: Fireflies transcript: ff_20260221_1622_answerflow-demo (attached).

Quotes / customer voice snippets:

- "If you can show 30-40% lower per-deflection cost we can justify replacing our rule engine for many flows." — Ops lead

Open questions / blockers:
- Security team needs a hands-on TTP for KMS and audit log export (delay ~2 wks).
- Engineering wants to see 99th-percentile latency under real spike with caching enabled.
- Pricing model: committed QPS vs pure usage — finance to decide.

Next steps (short):
